_readme: TUNING [the first kit is guns] 10/19 (rule 120(a), rule 117, rule 38g research only). draft:true. NOTHING IN THE GAME READS THIS FILE. The card is the live fight's own hitChance() and resolveAttack() on a flat lit board; the cells are fights of the live fight (slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html, headless, AUTO on both sides) with one line spliced into the memory copy so a row carrying per_tile/base_bonus uses them, seeded 9000+k so every kit and setting meets the same fights. The draft rows are proposals for COMBAT. Key: kind|company|enemies|kit|setting.
splice: if (typeof w.per_tile === 'number') { per = w.per_tile; base = w.base_bonus; free = w.free_tiles || 1; ignores = !!w.ignores_line_of_fire; }

pistol.name: DRAFT Pistol
pistol.why: two shots a turn like the Short Bow's Quick Shot (4 AP), the Short Bow's own damage (30-50) with a step more of it past the armour (45 against 35), a steeper fall per tile than any bow (a handgun is short), a bigger base so it still starts easier at two and three tiles

rifle.name: DRAFT Rifle
rifle.why: the Light Crossbow's reach (6) and direct share, a step more damage, the Aimed Shot's flat fall (-2 a tile), +20 where the bolt is +15; two shots a turn where the crossbow fires one (4 AP, not 3 then a 4 AP reload: a rifle has no crank)

shotgun.name: DRAFT Shotgun
shotgun.why: the Handgonne's shape (a big base, a steep fall, the spread ignores the line of fire) with a second tile and two shots a turn (4 AP, not 3 then a 9 AP reload), the low end a step up (40-75 against 35-75), a step more past the armour (30 against 25), still the weakest of the three on plate (the rifle passes 50)

today.name: TODAY: each man keeps the kit of his place in the line (14 of 15 origins: no gun that fires)

jobs.name: THE JOBS ON TODAY'S ROWS: the same slots, each gun on the Battle Brothers row it rides today (rifle the Light Crossbow, pistol the Dagger, shotgun the Handgonne)

bb.name: BATTLE BROTHERS' FIRST BOWS AND CROSSBOWS: the same slots holding its own first rows (Light Crossbow, Short Bow, Handgonne)

draft.name: THE DRAFT GUNS (the proposal): the same slots holding the three draft rows, two shots a turn, the butt at one tile

once.name: THE DRAFT GUNS AT THE CROSSBOW'S PACE: the proposal with the rifle and the shotgun at one shot a turn (5 AP), the butt on (what the rate is worth)

eye.name: THE DRAFT GUNS BY THE EYE: the proposal, the main man on the line, the rest handed their guns by their background's ranged skill (the best eye the first rifle), the worst eyes on the line

nobutt.name: THE DRAFT GUNS WITHOUT THE BUTT: the proposal, but a gun at one tile does nothing (rule 83 as the fight plays it: what the butt is worth)

far.name: THE OPENING: the proposal with the first band across the street (the fronts 8 tiles apart, columns 6 and 14, not 5): a search side test

allguns.name: ALL GUNS, NOBODY ON THE LINE: every man a draft gun, the butt on (a side test: the ring)

settings.name: BATTLE BROTHERS VETERAN, THE HARD END: today plus a level raising three stats
THE START (rule 117): your roll +5 theirs -5, a bad streak ends, their nerve 0.9, your breath 18, later crews, the party at 0.85, xp -0.05

shooters.name: the average starting man (ranged skill 40.6: the middle of the fifteen origins' first men, their backgrounds' rolls)
a born shooter (the Hunter background's middle, 55.5)

targets.name: a dire wolf (ranged defence 10, 130 hitpoints, its own hide 30 and 30)

armours.name: light: a Gambeson and a Hood (65 and 30), a thug's kind
heavy: a Worn Mail Shirt and a Nasal Helmet (110 and 105), a raider's kind
